procedure: cargo test --locked --workspace; credit tests for negative-equity grade D, secured-capacity pledge reuse, final bond coupon before principal, missed debt service default and exact 52-week interest carry; corporate lifecycle bank loan chain. Plus crates/cw-sim/tests/credit.rs: the final instalment clears the last cent to the named lender, and a missed instalment becomes arrears owed once, collected first, with the borrower past due until it clears. Accept-quote rate, term and capacity checks in commands::tests.
limitations: Ratings are explained in-game thresholds, not agency ratings. Secured capacity is a 50 percent tangible-asset rule; no external credit bureau.
